content: If return value of the function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC is other than E _OK, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall send a negative acknowledgement (NACK) by J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_NEGATIVE .
